rows.response_text: To clean a Le Creuset grill pan, firstly tackle difficult food stains by soaking the pan in warm water, without soap, for 15 minutes to loosen stuck-on food particles. After removing the pan from the water, pour 1 tsp. of mild hand dish-washing detergent into your kitchen sink and fill it with hot water. Place your Le Creuset grill pan in this soapy solution and scrub gently with a nylon dish scrubber. Then, rinse the grill pan with plain, warm water to get rid of the soapy solution. Finally, hand dry your Le Creuset cast iron grill pan with a dish towel to prevent rust.
